title: Fleisch (Meat Stew with Vegetables)
description: Prepared with beef, fat, and onion.
steps: Wash the meat and cut into large cubes
In 6 dkg hot fat, sauté 1 finely chopped onion until lightly browned
Add the meat and {{source-3}}

Add finely chopped lemon zest, capers, marjoram, carrots cooked in salted water and cut into noodle shapes, kohlrabi cut into cubes, and potatoes, plus raw chopped mushrooms
Let everything braise together a while longer
Serve the meat on a round dish

title: Fleischknödel (Meat Dumplings)
description: Prepared with beef, smoked ham, and ham.
steps: In a bowl, pour 4-5 ladles of boiling water over 30 dkg salted flour, stir smooth, and cover.
When cooled, form equal-sized dumplings from the dough, flatten on a floured board.
Place a meat ball inside each dumpling and seal the dough over it.
Cook the dumplings in a pot of boiling salted water for 8-10 minutes.
Lift onto a dish and pour over bread crumbs roasted in fat.
Serve with sauerkraut or lettuce salad.

For the filling: Heat 4 dkg fat, sauté 1 finely chopped onion and parsley, add finely chopped beef, ham, bacon, and bread crumbs with salt, pepper, and broth, simmer a few minutes, and form into equal-sized balls.

title: Fleischpastete (Meat Pastry)
description: A pastry dish made with meat, veal or meat, and rolls.

ingredients.name: leftover roasted veal or other meat scraps
ingredients.sourceText: leftover roasted veal or other meat scraps

ingredients.name: 4 softened rolls without crusts, wrung out well
ingredients.sourceText: 4 softened rolls without crusts, wrung out well

steps: Cut leftover roasted veal or other meat scraps very fine
Add 4 softened, wrung-out rolls without crusts and chop everything very fine with a chef's knife
With 60 decagrams of meat, beat 16 decagrams of butter until fluffy, add 6 eggs one by one, stir in the meat, salt, pepper, 8 decagrams breadcrumbs and mix very well
Brush a mold with butter and dust with flour
Place a layer of the beaten mixture in the mold, then a layer of braised green peas, then meat mixture again and so forth

Once everything is used up, cook the cake in steam, turn it out of the mold, pour 1/4 liter of cream over it and place it in the oven so the cream thickens, or serve with sugar sauce (sauce tartare) instead
One may also use thinly sliced truffles instead of green peas, or thinly sliced eggs with finely cut mushrooms

title: Fleischpuffer (Meat Patties)
description: Prepared with meat, fat or beef fat or bacon, and bread.

ingredients.name: 80 drachm raw, boned meat of any kind
ingredients.sourceText: 80 drachm raw, boned meat of any kind

ingredients.name: 60 drachm fat (beef fat or bacon), finely chopped
ingredients.sourceText: 60 drachm fat (beef fat or bacon), finely chopped

ingredients.name: 8 drachm crusts of bread, soaked in water and squeezed dry
ingredients.sourceText: 8 drachm crusts of bread, soaked in water and squeezed dry

steps: Finely chop together the meat and fat
Pound in a mortar with 2 whole eggs, squeezed bread crusts, 1 bay leaf, and sprigs of thyme
Season with salt and pepper
With a spoon, take portions of this forcemeat and place on a water-moistened board
Smooth with a knife and shape as desired, like fish cakes or sausages
Dust with flour
10 minutes before serving, place in a shallow casserole containing hot butter
Brown on each side for approximately 4 minutes with gentle movement
Pour off the fat, cover the patties with brown soup and an equal amount of cream
Add a little lemon juice if desired and bring to a boil once
Serve with rice, macaroni, or puree

title: Fleischschtrudel (Meat Strudel)
description: Prepared with beef or pork, fat, and onion.

ingredients.name: 35 dkg cooked beef or roast leftovers or ½ cooked pork spleen
ingredients.sourceText: 35 dkg cooked beef or roast leftovers or ½ cooked pork spleen

steps: Make a strudel dough from 15 dkg flour, 1 egg, salt, and ½ dl lukewarm water
Let rest under a warm casserole for 15 minutes
Stretch the dough not too thin and brush with egg white
Prepare the filling: finely chop 35 dkg cooked beef or roast leftovers or ½ cooked pork spleen
Heat 3 dkg fat in a casserole, sauté minced onion and parsley until golden
Add the meat and moisten with a little broth or water
Season with salt and pepper and keep warm
Distribute the filling on the stretched dough, trim the edges, and roll up the strudel
Using a floured spoon handle, measure off equal-sized pieces, cut them through, place on a floured board
Lay them in a large casserole in boiling beef broth for 8 minutes

title: Fleiſch (Braised Meat with Vegetables)
description: Prepared with meat, fat, and onion.
steps: Pound the meat, wash it, salt and pepper it, and lard it.
In 6 dkg hot fat, brown 1 large finely chopped onion until dark brown.
Add the meat and pour in broth or water.
Let it braise covered for 2 to 2½ hours, turning often and adding liquid as needed.
45 minutes before serving, add the diced potatoes, noodle-cut carrots, celery, green peas, and mushrooms that have been pre-cooked in salt water.
Let them braise until tender.
Dust the sauce lightly with flour, add cream and red wine, and bring to a boil.
Serve the meat and vegetables on a long platter with the sauce.

title: Foamed Quince Pudding (Gefäumtes Quittenkoch)
description: Prepared with quince, sugar, and eggs.
steps: Cook some pieces of quince, scrape them finely, and beat them through a hair sieve
From the quince use one-half pound, put the same amount of sugar and finely cut Seville orange and lemon peel in it
Beat foam from ten fresh eggs onto a sieve and add it piece by piece
It must be stirred together for a while
Then put it on a sheet lined with wafers and arrange it beautifully high and round
Cut a cross in the top and bake it in the same way in a cool oven

ingredients.name: prepared root vegetables (yellow turnip, parsley root, celery)

Cut prepared root vegetables into small dice, cook in salted water for 20 minutes, and drain

Mix potatoes, root vegetables, apple, cucumber, mayonnaise, peas, mustard, salt, oil, and vinegar together

Slice or cut 2 hard-boiled eggs into 8 pieces
Wash and cook the red beet for 2 hours, peel, cut into thin slices or julienne strips
Wash salad greens and dress with salt, vinegar, and oil
Decorate the cone with hard eggs, red beet, and salad greens

title: Französischer Senf (French Mustard)
description: Prepared with mustard, vinegar, and onions.

ingredients.name: very strong vinegar, strengthened by frost
ingredients.sourceText: very strong vinegar, strengthened by frost

ingredients.name: marjoram, 1 loth per measure of vinegar
ingredients.sourceText: marjoram, 1 loth per measure of vinegar

ingredients.name: tarragon (Drachenkraut), 2 loth per measure of vinegar
ingredients.sourceText: tarragon (Drachenkraut), 2 loth per measure of vinegar

ingredients.name: thyme, 1 loth per measure of vinegar
ingredients.sourceText: thyme, 1 loth per measure of vinegar

ingredients.name: sage, 1 loth per measure of vinegar
ingredients.sourceText: sage, 1 loth per measure of vinegar

ingredients.name: rocambole onions (Roccombolenzwiebeln), 2 loth per measure of vinegar
ingredients.sourceText: rocambole onions (Roccombolenzwiebeln), 2 loth per measure of vinegar

steps: Pound good yellow mustard in a mortar and warm it in a pan until the oil can be pressed out with the fingers
Press it strongly and pound it into fine powder

To one measure of very strong vinegar that has been strengthened by frost, add 1 loth marjoram, 2 loth tarragon, and 1 loth each of thyme and sage, all dried and finely chopped, then add 2 loth rocambole onions
Let this steep in the sun for 5 to 6 days, then strain it through
Take 2 pounds of the mustard powder, 1 pound of pounded sugar or more, 12 loth each of cinnamon, ginger, and allspice (all pounded), and 1 quenchen of fennel seeds
Mix everything well and make it into a paste with as much vinegar as necessary

title: French Pastry Dough (Pâte Brisée)
description: Prepared with egg yolks, flour, and butter.
steps: Place the flour on a table and make a depression in it
Into this depression put the butter, salt, egg yolks from the eggs, and one glass of water, more or less according to the proportion of other ingredients
Work the butter with the water, eggs, and salt
Ensure the butter is very soft, gradually mix in the flour, and gather everything together well
Once this dough is well compressed, knead it with your fingers until it has thoroughly combined; if it is too dry, moisten it somewhat
Do not knead this dough more than twice, as it could become grainy, especially in summer, and therefore not hold together properly

title: Fribattcn (Omelettes)
description: Prepared with dough and lard.

ingredients.name: dough made from 1.5 liters flour, 1.5 liters milk, and 3 whole eggs
ingredients.sourceText: dough made from 1.5 liters flour, 1.5 liters milk, and 3 whole eggs

steps: Heat some lard in a casserole until very hot.
Add a small amount of lard to a flat pan with a handle and let the pan become very hot.
Pour the fat back into the casserole and add approximately 2 tablespoons of dough to the pan, spread about paper-thin.
Place the pan back on the fire and add some fat from the side.
Flip the omelette with a pastry spoon and add a little more fat.
Place the browned omelettes on blotting paper and continue until the dough is finished.
The omelettes can be cut into strips or decorative shapes as desired.
Note: It is especially important that the lard for frying is very hot, otherwise the mushrooms and omelettes will fall apart.

title: Fribatten mit Spanischem Aufguß (Crepes with Spanish Sauce)
description: A sauce made with marmalade, almond paste, and egg whites.
steps: Fill the baked crepes with any marmalade, roll together and divide each one into two parts
Lightly mix the firm snow from 4 egg whites with 6 hectograms finely powdered sugar

Spread some Spanish almond paste on a round bowl coated with butter, place the filled crepes cut into pieces on top, cover these again with the paste and continue alternately until everything is used and the bowl is arranged heaped
The last layer is paste, dust with finely powdered sugar, then let dry in the open oven for 0.5 hour
While baking, turn the bowl in the oven several times so that the almond paste gets an even color
When a yellow crust has formed, take the bowl from the oven and sprinkle the crust with warm marmalade

title: Fricassee of Leftover Roasted Veal (Fricaſſee von uͤbrig gebliebenem Kalbsbraten)
description: Prepared with veal, beef broth, and onion.
steps: Remove the brown surface from the roast, cut it into pieces, sweat it in a casserole with butter, add beef broth, salt, pepper, mace, and a half small diced onion, let everything cook together for a short time.
Then stir a couple of egg yolks with a little vinegar, add some finely chopped parsley to it, and pour it into the veal, after which let it become thick over the fire.

title: Fricaſſirte Fröſche (Fricasseed Frogs)
description: Prepared with onion, broth, and egg yolks.
steps: Warm a piece of butter in a pan
Add a spoonful of flour and half an onion
Let it cook only a moment until it does not brown
Fill with pea broth
Add some lemon peel and let it cook for a while
Place the frogs in the sauce
Add a spoonful of milk cream and let simmer somewhat more
In a small pot, take two or three egg yolks, half a spoonful of cold water and the juice of a lemon
Strain the sauce into this mixture
Heat constantly at a coal fire while stirring
Pour over the frogs on a platter
Sprinkle with lemon peel

title: Fridatten mit Champignonfülle (Pancakes with Mushroom Filling)
description: Prepared with mushrooms, broth or water, and lemon juice.
steps: Clean, wash, and finely chop the mushrooms
In 4 dkg hot butter, lightly fry chopped parsley

Let stew for 8-10 minutes (should not be very wet)
Spread the mushroom mixture on the pancakes and roll
Place in a buttered dish
Pour milk beaten with 1 egg yolk over
Bake in the oven for 15-20 minutes

The neck with head can remain on one quarter and be fried together.
Stomach and liver can also be breaded and fried last.

title: Friederiken-Torte (Friederike Cake)
description: A cake made with almonds, nuts, and jam.
steps: Make crumb dough on board from butter, sugar, and swollen grated almonds
Let rest 15 minutes
Divide into 4 parts and roll each round like cake form base
Place each dough layer on unbuttered baking sheet
Bake at higher heat
Coat two layers with nut filling, third layer with jam
Assemble together and place fourth layer on top
Press down
Let cake stand 1-2 days
Sprinkle with sugar or glaze white
For nut filling: Cook grated nuts, raw grated almonds, sugar, and lemon zest with 1 dl water for several minutes, then cool

title: Frosch-Suppe (Frog Soup)
description: A soup made with turnips, champignons, and water or broth.

ingredients.name: Madeira wine, white table wine, or champagne (optional)
ingredients.sourceText: Madeira wine, white table wine, or champagne (optional)

steps: Cook the turnips in 1 liter of pea water
Roast the champignons in 5 decagrams of butter
Add the whole frogs or frog legs to the champignons and cook until tender in 2 liters of pea water or broth
Remove the meat from the frog bones and set aside
Pound the frog bones with the cooked turnips and champignons
Stir this mixture together well with the soup
Season and bind with 4 egg yolks and 1/4 liter of cream mixed together
Pass through a sieve
Add the frog meat back to the soup
Serve with fried turnips
Optionally add Madeira wine, white table wine, or champagne

title: Frühlings- oder Sommer-Suppe (Spring or Summer Soup)

Let this soup cook until everything is tender and, after it has been properly seasoned, serve it over roasted bread rolls.

title: Gallerte von Krebsen und Schnecken (Crayfish and Snail Jelly)
description: Prepared with crayfish, snails, and veal.

ingredients.name: Two cleaned and finely chopped veal feet
ingredients.sourceText: Two cleaned and finely chopped veal feet

ingredients.name: (two and a half measures) of spring water
ingredients.sourceText: 8 pounds (two and a half measures) of spring water

ingredients.name: Half a quench of ground nutmeg
ingredients.sourceText: Half a quench of ground nutmeg

steps: Clean the crayfish and snails as if they were to be eaten
Pound them small
Set them with the fresh butter on a gentle fire
Add the chopped veal feet and spring water
Let them cook together until only one pound of broth remains
Throw in the ground nutmeg and handful of chervil herb
Let it boil once more and press it through linen cloth
Set it in the cellar so it congeals like a jelly
This amount provides food for four to five days
A wasted patient who digests well takes two spoonfuls each morning, midday and evening, dissolved in about six spoonfuls of unsalted chicken broth

title: Gans, im Ofen gebraten (Goose, Roasted in the Oven)
description: Prepared with goose, bacon, and onions.
steps: Clean the goose as is proper, dry it well, and place it in an oblong roasting pan with bacon, whole small onions, salt, pepper, and seasonings
Pour in some bouillon and white wine, and roast it in the oven at moderate heat
Baste it often from time to time and turn it
When it is roasted through, skim off the fat, dress the goose on the plate, garnish it all around with the onions, and give the fond, reduced briefly and strained, over it
Alternatively, small English potatoes can be roasted with the goose, glazed, and used to garnish it
The geese may also, for variety, be filled with cooked quince or apple marmalade, with raisins, chestnuts, etc., when they are roasted

title: Gebackene Creme (Baked Cream)
description: Prepared with orange or water or lemon peel, bread crumbs, and lard.

ingredients.name: orange blossom water or lemon peel or some orange water
ingredients.sourceText: orange blossom water or lemon peel or some orange water

steps: Cook about 1/2 Mass of good milk down and set it aside
In a bowl, beat 2 spoonfuls of fine flour with 4 eggs, then mix this with the milk very well so it does not become grainy
Let it come together on gentle charcoal heat, but do not boil
While constantly stirring, add 1/4 pound of finely sifted sugar, a nutmeg-sized piece of butter, and a few drops of orange blossom water
Place it back on the charcoal and stir constantly until it becomes thick
Coat a cake sheet with butter and pipe the cream a thumb-thick onto it
When it has cooled, cut it into oblong or square pieces, coat them with bread crumbs, and fry them nicely in lard
After sprinkling with sugar, glaze them in the oven

title: Gebackene Crème à Pangloise (Baked Cream à Pangloise)
description: Prepared with bitter almonds, lemon, and milk.
steps: Let 1 mass and 3 seidel milk with one piece cinnamon boil several times

Beat 15 whole eggs in a pot with one quarter pound bitter almonds finely grated on a grater, three eighth pound sugar equally finely grated, and the zest of one lemon also grated, and whisk for a quarter hour
Pour the hot milk to it while stirring very strongly
Pour the cream onto a plate and let it become firm in a lukewarm oven
It can be served cold or warm, or the plate can be set on a casserole with boiling water, covered with a fitting lid, and the cream allowed to become firm in this way
All creams must not stand too hot, otherwise they become blistery, which is not good

steps: In a deep bowl, place {{source-0}} and gradually pour in {{source-1}} while stirring constantly until the dough is completely smooth.
Beat in 3 whole eggs and let it rest somewhat.
Heat beef and pork lard in a small baking pan until very hot.

Dip the mushroom mold into the hot fat, let it become very hot, remove it, turn it over so all fat drips off, quickly dip it halfway into the dough, then quickly place the mold back in the hot fat and hold it there until the mushroom has a beautiful brown color.
Carefully remove the baked mushroom with a spoon (as it is very fragile) and place it on a sieve lined with blotting paper, which will absorb any excess fat.
Fill these mushrooms either with soup or with ragout.

title: Gebratene Ganz (Braised Goose)
description: Prepared with goose, bacon, and ham.
steps: Clean the goose very thoroughly, open it, remove the insides and wash it.
Cut off the neck at the breast bone and the wings at the second joint, push the meat from the thighs of the third joint to the body, and remove these thighs as well as the feet below the knee.
Tuck the wings under the breast and truss the goose.
Sprinkle it with salt and pepper.
Put bacon slices into a casserole along with 12 ounces of raw ham, then onion and root vegetables, all finely sliced, 1 bay leaf and whole spices.
Place the goose on top and braise covered.
After 1/2 hour, pour 1 liter of broth and 1 liter of white wine over it and let the goose braise covered until completely tender - about 1 hour for a young goose, 2 hours for an old one.
Remove it then, degrease and pass the broth.

When serving, remove twine and bacon, proceed as with venison back, and garnish neatly with aspic

Lay the hare on top
Pour approximately 0.375 liter white wine and the same amount of soup over it
Let this braise covered slowly for approximately 1.5 hours
Remove the hare and serve in pieces on a platter
Remove fat from the braise, reduce it slightly and serve as sauce
Alternatively, this dish can be served cold; let the hare cool in the braise and stand until it sets to jelly
When serving, remove twine and bacon, proceed as with venison back, and garnish neatly with aspic

title: Gedämpftes Rindfleisc (Braised Beef)
description: Prepared with beef, tongues, and bacon.
steps: Lard a beautiful piece of beef (hip-shank) with salted and elongated cut tongues and bacon, and salt it.
In a braising pan, put fresh bacon, onion, yellow turnips, parsley root, and celery, sliced in leaves.
Add lemon peel and whole pepper, and belly herb.
Lay the beef on top, add half wine, some vinegar and water, and let it stew well covered.
When soft enough, remove the meat and skim off the fat.
Let the root vegetables cook down well.
Before plating, put the meat back in the pan and let it braise a little more.
Place it on a plate, pass one portion of the sauce through a sieve over it, and serve the other portion of sauce in a bowl.

title: Gedämpftes Rindfleiſch (Steamed Beef)
description: Prepared with beef, vegetables, and onion.
steps: Prepare beef as usual for soup.
One hour before serving, clean, wash and slice the vegetables into leaves.
Roast the vegetables, onion, peppercorns, spice kernels, bay leaf and thyme in hot fat until dark.
Remove the beef from the soup and place it in the vegetables.
Pour on a little water, cover and braise, pouring in more liquid occasionally.
The sauce should be nicely brown.
Remove the beef, dust the sauce with flour, strain it, season with vinegar and cook together with the beef again.
Slice the beef and serve with the sauce on a long platter.

title: Gedünstete Rolladen (Braised Beef Rolls)
description: A bread preparation made with beef, onion, and breadcrumbs.

ingredients.name: beef suitable for stewing, cut into hand-wide, lengthwise pieces, no thicker than a knife back
ingredients.sourceText: beef suitable for stewing, cut into hand-wide, lengthwise pieces, no thicker than a knife back

ingredients.name: one brain, cooked in salt water
ingredients.sourceText: one brain, cooked in salt water

steps: Take a piece of beef suitable for stewing and cut it into hand-wide, lengthwise pieces, but no thicker than a knife back
Beat and salt them
Cook a brain in salt water, cleanly remove the skin, chop it fine, and braise it in butter with some green parsley
Add some finely chopped onion, salt, pepper, and a handful of breadcrumbs, also one spoonful of broth, let it come to a boil and cool
Chop a small piece of bacon finely, mix it with the brain, coat the meat with it, and tie it together with twine
Put bacon, onion, and yellow turnips in a casserole, lay the rolls in it and braise them until they have braised their sauce into themselves and become brownish
Take them out, put a couple spoonfuls of flour in the casserole, let it brown, then fill it with broth
Add some vinegar and lemon peel, let the sauce cook well, strain it, lay the rolls in it again, add two spoonfuls of cream milk and let it braise a bit more
Arrange the rolls in a row on the dish, strain sauce over them and sprinkle with lengthwise-cut lemon peel

title: Gedünsteter Reis Pilau (Steamed Rice Pilau)
description: Prepared with rice, onion, and water.
steps: Place 16 deka rice in a casserole
Pour in enough cold water to cover it by a finger's height
Add 8 deka butter, {{source-3}}, 1 small Spanish onion, and 5 bundles of fresh parsley
Stir well together and let the rice steam covered for 10-15 minutes
The liquid will evaporate and each grain of rice will remain separate
Remove the onion and parsley and use the rice as a garnish for various meat dishes
If a crust is desired on the rice, add 2 deka butter after the rice has steamed, and let it roast uncovered for a few minutes

title: Gedünstetes Rindfleisc mit einer Kruste von Erdäpfeln (Braised Beef with a Potato Crust)
description: Prepared with beef, bacon, and onion.

ingredients.name: butter, about the size of half an egg
ingredients.sourceText: butter, about the size of half an egg

steps: Cook the beef soft, then place it in a casserole with bacon slices, onion, and yellow turnips, turning it often so it browns on all sides.
Remove it, dust a spoonful of flour on it, and when the flour has browned, fill halfway with good broth and halfway with red wine.
Once it has cooked through, strain it.
Using a hollow iron, form small balls from kohlrabi and yellow turnips, place them in the sauce, and cook them soft.
While this happens, cook three large potatoes and peel them; once cold, grate them on a grater.
Beat a piece of butter the size of half an egg, and mix well with the grated potatoes, some finely chopped fresh parsley, salt, two whole eggs, and two egg yolks.
Coat the upper part of the meat evenly one finger thick with this mixture and bake it in a hot oven until the crust is beautifully brown.
When plating, place the meat in the middle of the plate, the small brown sauce on the bottom of the plate, and form a wreath around it with the braised kohlrabi and yellow turnips.

title: Geflügel mit Oliven (Poultry with Olives)
description: Prepared with olives, bacon or fat, and onion.
steps: Put finely sliced bacon or other fat into a casserole, also 1 piece of onion, some parsley, thyme thinly sliced, 5 bunches of thyme, 5 pieces of juniper berries, then lay the dressed and salted poultry on it, cover it with bacon slices, and let it fry a little covered.

Pour over with as much wine and broth that the liquid covers it, add 8 ounces of thinly sliced black bread, and let the poultry braise until tender; then remove it, defat and strain the liquid, and add 12 pieces of peeled and pitted olives and some cream, adjust the taste if necessary with lemon juice, and serve this sauce with the poultry.
All kinds of poultry, especially older poultry, can be prepared in this manner.

title: Gefrorener Hasenkuchen (Jellied Hare Cake)
description: A cake made with hare or venison or meat, bacon, and berries.

ingredients.name: boned hare or venison meat
ingredients.sourceText: 1 kilogram boned hare or venison meat

steps: Pound hare or venison meat finely in mortar with 66 decagrams cut bacon and 5 juniper berries
Pass through a sieve
Cut the 2½ decagrams bacon, tongue, and truffles into small cubes
Mix cubed ingredients with the pâté, salt, and spices
Brush a mold with butter, line with flour, and cover with thin bacon slices
Press the pâté in and cover with bacon slices that have been cut several times
Place the mold in boiling water and cook covered for 2 hours, with ¾ of the mold in water
Refill evaporated water as needed
After cooking, turn out and let cool covered with the bacon slice
Prepare a cleaned mold in ice and pour finger-high aspic into it
When set, garnish with cooled tongue, side of a hard-cooked egg, and cut truffles
Pour finger-high aspic over these additions
When fully cooled, trim the cake in the mold and carefully place in the mold
Fill the space between mold and cake with melted aspic
After standing in ice for 1 hour, remove the mold, dip in hot water for a moment, dry, turn out onto a dish, carefully remove the mold, and border the dish edge with neatly cut aspic

title: Gefärkielter (Gemürkelter) Rostbraten (Stuffed Pot Roast)
description: Prepared with bacon, onion, and meat.

ingredients.name: 16 Deca Speck, fein geschnitten (16 deca bacon, finely cut)
ingredients.sourceText: 16 Deca Speck, fein geschnitten (16 deca bacon, finely cut)

ingredients.name: Zwiebel und Petersilie, fein geschnitten (onion and parsley, finely cut)

ingredients.name: 6 Deca rohes Reichfleisch (6 deca raw meat)

ingredients.name: Fein geschnittenes Wurzelwerk (finely cut root vegetables)
ingredients.sourceText: Fein geschnittenes Wurzelwerk (finely cut root vegetables)

steps: Take 5 pot roasts and pound out 4 of them flat.
Finely mince the 5th piece with 16 deca bacon, some onion and parsley using a chef's knife.
Mix this filling with 6 deca raw meat, some salt, and pepper if desired.
Divide the filling into 4 portions and spread knife-back thickness on each pounded pot roast.
Roll each piece up and tie lightly with twine.
In a casserole add some fat, finely cut root vegetables and some onion.
Place the breaded, rolled pot roasts on top, let them braise briefly, then pour 3/4 liter broth over them.
Cover with a lid and braise gently, which takes 1 to 1.5 hours.
Place on a platter, remove the twine and slice neatly.
Add some brown broth to the sauce, let it come to a boil briefly and pour over the pot roasts.
Alternatively: degrease the sauce, add some cream and capers, let it boil and pour over.

Or: add finely diced raw potatoes and 6 pieces of cleaned and cut anchovies to the filling instead of meat. Before the rolled pot roasts are fully braised, degrease the sauce, add sour cream and finish braising.
Or: finely chop a small head of cabbage, braise it in butter, and mix with finely cut pot roast, some finely chopped ham, some caraway, and pepper if desired; proceed as above.

Or: pound together 8 deca bacon, 1 softened and well-pressed roll, some onion, 9 raw parsley sprigs, anchovies, capers, some lemon peel, the 5th piece of pot roast and 2 whole eggs; season with salt and spices, sieve and spread on the pot roasts, then proceed as above.
For any of these preparations you can substitute 4 tablespoons of finely cut cooked ham for the anchovies.
Or: mix the 5th piece of finely cut pot roast with the filling of 16 deca bratwurst, which is also highly recommended for cabbage-filled pot roasts.

Or: add finely diced raw potatoes and 6 pieces of cleaned and cut anchovies to the filling instead of meat. Before the rolled pot roasts are fully braised, degrease the sauce, add sour cream and finish braising.
Or: finely chop a small head of cabbage, braise it in butter, and mix with finely cut pot roast, some finely chopped ham, some caraway, and pepper if desired; proceed as above.

Or: pound together 8 deca bacon, 1 softened and well-pressed roll, some onion, 9 raw parsley sprigs, anchovies, capers, some lemon peel, the 5th piece of pot roast and 2 whole eggs; season with salt and spices, sieve and spread on the pot roasts, then proceed as above.
For any of these preparations you can substitute 4 tablespoons of finely cut cooked ham for the anchovies.
Or: mix the 5th piece of finely cut pot roast with the filling of 16 deca bratwurst, which is also highly recommended for cabbage-filled pot roasts.

title: Gefüllte Kalbsmilch (Stuffed Calf Sweetbread)
description: Prepared with sweetbread, breadcrumbs, and bacon.
steps: The larger part of a calf sweetbread is sliced open and the interior is scraped onto a clean cutting board with a knife back.
To this add breadcrumbs softened in milk, some green parsley, a small sprig of stripped marjoram herb, and if desired basil and bacon.
Cut all of this finely together, place in a deep bowl, salt it, season with some pepper and if desired nutmeg, stir in 1 whole egg and 1 egg yolk.
With this mixture, fill the sweetbread, sew it shut and cook gently in salt water.
Then remove it and either roast it at the fire or fry it with butter in a pan, then cut the sweetbread into desired slices and serve it with fine vegetables, or serve it in the soup pot.

title: Gefüllte Kohlrabi (Stuffed Kohlrabi)
description: Prepared with veal, onion, and crawfish or green peas.

ingredients.name: Half a roll soaked in milk
ingredients.sourceText: Half a roll soaked in milk

ingredients.name: Crawfish tails or green peas, as desired
ingredients.sourceText: Crawfish tails or green peas, as desired

steps: Cook young kohlrabi in salt water until half soft
Cut off the top and hollow them out well
For the filling: finely chop a piece of cooked or stewed veal, half a roll soaked in milk, some green parsley, an onion the size of a hazelnut, and some of the scooped out kohlrabi
Add crawfish tails or green peas if desired
Mix all in a bowl with 2 spoons of cream, 1 whole egg, 2 egg yolks, salt, ground pepper and a little nutmeg
Fill the kohlrabi and replace the caps
For the butter sauce: let 2 spoons of flour turn light brown in a piece of warm butter, fill with good broth, add ground nutmeg and 2 spoons of sweet cream
Place the filled kohlrabi in this sauce, cover with white paper and then an iron lid
Cook slowly so they remain white with heat applied above and below
Or for brown stewed kohlrabi: heat the butter, add roughly crushed sugar, and when brown add the kohlrabi (previously tied together with string), browning them on all sides
Remove them, add yellow turnips and onion pieces to the pan, dust with flour, and let cook well with some broth
Place kohlrabi in another pan, strain the sauce over it, place on heat, and when cooked through, arrange on the dish and serve with fried chicken, etc.

title: Gefüllte Nürteln (Filled Pastry Rolls)
description: A bread preparation made with egg yolks, yeast, and melted butter.

ingredients.name: 3 decagrams pressed yeast dissolved in 1/2 liter lukewarm milk
ingredients.sourceText: 3 decagrams pressed yeast dissolved in 1/2 liter lukewarm milk

ingredients.name: filling such as poppy seed, nut filling, compote or marmalade
ingredients.sourceText: 1 teaspoon of filling such as poppy seed, nut filling, compote or marmalade

steps: Beat the butter until fluffy, gradually stir in the sugar, salt, egg yolks, and whole egg
Mix in the pressed yeast dissolved in lukewarm milk and the flour, stirring well
Beat the dough until it separates from the spoon
Cover with a cloth and let it rise in a warm place
When risen, place the dough on a flour-dusted board, roll it out to the thickness of a small finger, and cut into strips 3 fingers wide and 1 finger long
Fill each strip with 1 teaspoon of desired filling such as poppy seed, nut filling, compote or marmalade
Roll up the filling in the dough and lay the rolls in a butter-greased casserole so that the ends of the rolled dough face upward
Brush with melted butter at the points where the rolls touch each other
Cover with a cloth and let rise in a warm place until the dough has risen again
Brush with melted butter and bake slowly for 3/4 to 1 hour
Remove the casserole, turn out the rolls, separate them from each other, arrange on a plate, sprinkle with sugar, and serve

title: Gefüllte Schnecken (Stuffed Snails)
description: Prepared with snails, mushrooms, and capers.
steps: Place 20 cleaned snails in boiling salted water and cook for approximately 20 minutes
Remove snails and extract them from their shells using a dressing needle
Remove the head, intestines, and small stone from inside the shell
Chop the remaining snail meat into pieces
Finely chop 2 pieces mushrooms, 5 sprigs parsley, 1 half-finger-length piece lemon peel, and 4 pieces peeled capers together
Roast this mixture in 8 drams butter
Add {{source-7}} and the chopped snails to the roasted mixture
Once completely cooled, mix with 3 egg yolks and {{source-9}} and set in a cool place
Clean the removed shells with warm water and salt, place on a sieve, and once completely dry, fill with the prepared cold mixture
Place the filled shells in a casserole, cover with milk cream, sprinkle with breadcrumbs, drizzle with melted butter
Bake for approximately 1/2 hour
Remove from oven, arrange on a napkin-covered dish, and serve with vinegar and oil

title: Gefüllte, Gebratene Tauben (Stuffed, Roasted Pigeons)
description: Prepared with pigeons and veal.
steps: The pigeons are feathered (plucked), flamed, gutted, washed, and the neck, head and feet are cut off. The leg bone is pushed back, the thighbone is tucked inward and with the index finger from behind toward front the skin is separated from the meat. The pigeons are salted inside and outside and filled with the forcemeat of veal breast, namely the mass is spread between the skin and breast down to the thighs and the wings are turned inward against the back over the skin of the neck so that the skin is held secure by this. The pigeons are then placed in a pan, covered with hot fat and roasted in the oven for about 1/2 hour with frequent basting. After this time they are removed, the string is cut, pulled out, each pigeon is cut lengthwise in the middle and arranged on a dish with any salad served alongside. The pigeons can instead of breadcrumb forcemeat be filled with liver forcemeat.

title: Gefüllter Hecht (Stuffed Pike)
description: Prepared with pike, breadcrumbs, and crayfish.

ingredients.name: 10 decagrams breadcrumbs soaked in milk and squeezed dry
ingredients.sourceText: 10 decagrams breadcrumbs soaked in milk and squeezed dry

steps: Lay the pike on a board. Cut the skin on the back from tail toward head and separate it 2 finger-widths from the head on each side.
Carefully pull the skin from the flesh and spread it completely on the board.
Remove all flesh from the skeleton using a small knife, taking care not to damage the head and skin.
Leave the skeleton covered with spread skin, sprinkle lightly with salt and cover with a cloth dampened in cold water.

Make the forcemeat: Finely chop {{source-3}} with 10 decagrams breadcrumbs that have been soaked in milk and pressed dry, 6 cleaned and washed crayfish tails, 1 mushroom that has been roasted with 5 bunches finely chopped parsley in 200 grams butter.
Pound this finely in a mortar, then add 3 whole eggs and 3 egg yolks and mix well.
Add {{source-11}} and pound together.
Press through a sieve, season with salt and pepper, and stir well.
Spread this forcemeat on the skeleton, coat well, and draw the skin together on the back.
Insert a piece of wood from the mouth to the tail, which must protrude during roasting.
Hold the fish by the head and tail and place it in a pan containing 200 grams butter.
Brush with melted butter, cover with buttered paper, and roast in a moderate oven, frequently basting with its own juices for approximately 45 minutes to 1 hour.
If roasting with cream, after 15 minutes pour 500 milliliters cream over it and continue basting frequently.
Garnish with fresh parsley, lemon slices, and serve with potatoes, or arrange on a platter and garnish with forcemeat quenelles, crayfish, crayfish tails, truffles if desired, and fried smelt.
Serve with Hollandaise or mustard sauce or butter sauce with lemon juice.

Make the forcemeat: Finely chop 200 grams pike flesh with 10 decagrams breadcrumbs that have been soaked in milk and pressed dry, 6 cleaned and washed crayfish tails, 1 mushroom that has been roasted with 5 bunches finely chopped parsley in 200 grams butter.
Pound this finely in a mortar, then add 3 whole eggs and 3 egg yolks and mix well.
Add 140 grams butter and pound together.
Press through a sieve, season with salt and pepper, and stir well.
Spread this forcemeat on the skeleton, coat well, and draw the skin together on the back.
Insert a piece of wood from the mouth to the tail, which must protrude during roasting.
Hold the fish by the head and tail and place it in a pan containing 200 grams butter.
Brush with melted butter, cover with buttered paper, and roast in a moderate oven, frequently basting with its own juices for approximately 45 minutes to 1 hour.
If roasting with cream, after 15 minutes pour 500 milliliters cream over it and continue basting frequently.
Garnish with fresh parsley, lemon slices, and serve with potatoes, or arrange on a platter and garnish with forcemeat quenelles, crayfish, crayfish tails, truffles if desired, and fried smelt.
Serve with Hollandaise or mustard sauce or butter sauce with lemon juice.

title: Gefüllter Kalbsmagen (Stuffed Veal Stomach)
description: Prepared with veal, cabbage, and onion.
steps: The leaves from a small cabbage head are separated, cooked in salt water, removed, dried with a cloth and finely cut with a sharp knife.

In fat, roast finely cut green parsley and some onion, add the cut cabbage with rendered, milk-softened, well-squeezed breadcrumbs, salt it, season with savory and some caraway and let it braise covered.
Then set it aside and when it is completely cooled, stir in 2 whole eggs and 2 egg yolks.
The stomach from a calf, after being carefully cleaned, is filled with this mixture, then sewn shut and cooked gently in salt water for about 2 hours.
Lay the stomach in a casserole containing hot butter, roast it on both sides until golden and then cut it into desired pieces.

In a casserole put 1 tablespoon of flour, gradually pour in, while constantly stirring, 1/3 liter of cream and stir this until it begins to boil, then add 1 tablespoon of capers, let it boil once and serve with the prepared veal stomach.

title: Gefüllter Kohl (Stuffed Cabbage)
description: Prepared with cabbage, meat, and bacon.
steps: Clean the cabbage but do not separate, wash it, place in boiling salt water and cook uncovered 4-6 minutes depending on size, remove and drain, cool it.
Fold back the leaves, brush with filling, press together so the head regains its former shape and wrap lightly with twine.

In a casserole, heat 5 dag fat, let a finely chopped onion lightly brown, lay some bacon slices, then the cabbage on top, let it braise in the oven under frequent basting with broth or water for 1 hour.
Remove the twine, serve the cabbage on a round dish.
For the filling: finely chop the smoked meat and mix with a water-soaked, well-squeezed roll, salt, pepper and chopped parsley.

title: Gefüllter Lungenbraten (Stuffed Beef Tenderloin)
description: Prepared with beef, bacon, and shallots.
steps: Carefully cut a small beef tenderloin lengthwise from the thinner side so that it can be opened but not divided into two pieces
Finely chop 16 deca of bacon, 6 shallots, 1 strong tablespoon capers, 1 anchovy, and 4 sprigs parsley on a cutting board with a knife
Spread this mixture on the inner, cut side of the tenderloin
Roll the tenderloin together and wrap it with twine
In a casserole, place fat, 1 onion, some root vegetables, 12 deca black bread, all cut into thin slices, 5 grains spice, 8 sprigs parsley, and the bones removed and broken from the tenderloin
Place the meat on top so that the open side faces upward
Braise covered for 1/2 hour
Add enough broth so the meat is almost covered and braise covered for about 1.5 hours in the oven until tender
Remove the meat and skim the fat from the sauce
Add 1/4 cream to the sauce and let it boil
In a second casserole, place the skimmed fat, then the meat freed from the twine, cover with {{source-16}} and roast in the oven until it gets a brown crust
Strain the sauce, let it boil somewhat and pour it over the meat cut into desired pieces
The sauce must be thick and piquant and can also be served in a sauce boat
Garnish the tenderloin with potatoes, macaroni, small cucumbers and the like

title: Gekochter Schinken (Boiled Ham)
description: Prepared with ham, berries, and bay leaf.
steps: Scrape the skin off the ham, leaving the ham bone slightly protruding
Place the ham in a large casserole with the skin side down
Add 5 crushed juniper berries, 1 bay leaf, and some sprigs of thyme
Fill the casserole with boiling water and cook the ham slowly and covered
If the broth tastes strongly of salt, drain it and replace with boiling water during cooking
Once the ham is tender, which can be tested by inserting a fork, remove it and place on a board with the skin side up
Cover with another board, weight it down with a heavy weight, and let it cool
The next day, remove the weight and board, loosen the skin slightly, replace it, and cut thin slices as needed
Arrange on a plate and garnish with chopped aspic, and serve with mustard and horseradish

title: Gelee von Rheinwein (Rhine Wine Jelly)
description: Prepared with wine, calf's feet, and lemon.
steps: Slit the calf's feet at the hoof and divide them apart, remove the long middle bone and discard it
Cook the feet with 2 measures of water for 4 hours, skimming often but without salting
Pass them through a hair cloth
Set them again on charcoal fire to reduce to half and become a thick stock
Add one bottle of Rhine wine, half a pound of sugar with the zest of one lemon rubbed into it, and the juice, without letting it boil so the fine flavor does not escape
Clarify the jelly with the foam from 6 eggs
Filter it
Fill into the mold
Set in a cool place

title: Gemeine Wilde Ente (Common Wild Duck)
description: Prepared with bacon or marrow, onion, and vegetables.
steps: Put some bacon or marrow, onion and root vegetables, all finely sliced, into a casserole dish along with 5 crushed juniper berries, 5 grains each of various spices, sprigs of thyme, and 1 bay leaf.
Place the prepared duck on top, cover it with bacon slices and roast uncovered.
After this, add 8 ounces of finely sliced black bread along with 7/8 liter red wine, 7/8 liter vinegar and broth, so that the liquid barely covers the duck.
Let it braise covered until the duck is tender - a young duck will need about 1 hour, an old duck about 2 hours.
Remove the meat and place it with the duck into a shallow casserole dish and set it in the oven.
After a few minutes, pour 1/4 liter of cream over the duck and let it reduce well.

In the meantime, make a fairly dark butter sauce from 8 ounces butter and 8 ounces flour, pour this over the reduced broth, add 2 ounces sugar and necessary seasoning, stir well, bring to a boil again, pass through a sieve and remove the fat.
Arrange the carved duck on a platter, pour some sauce over it and serve the rest in a sauce boat.
Garnish the duck with puff pastry cut into desired shapes and fresh parsley.

In the meantime, make a fairly dark butter sauce from 8 ounces butter and 8 ounces flour, pour this over the reduced broth, add 2 ounces sugar and necessary seasoning, stir well, bring to a boil again, pass through a sieve and remove the fat.
Arrange the carved duck on a platter, pour some sauce over it and serve the rest in a sauce boat.
Garnish the duck with puff pastry cut into desired shapes and fresh parsley.

title: Gemüse in Essig (Vegetables in Vinegar)
description: Prepared with vinegar, green beans, and turnips.
steps: Mix 2 parts white vinegar with 1 part saffron, spices, and some mixed spices and simmer for approximately 1/2 hour (skim off the foam that forms)
Let it cool in an earthen, glass, or porcelain vessel

Cook each type of vegetable - green beans, young small yellow turnips, small onions, small cauliflower pieces, shallots, rocambole, artichoke hearts, small cucumber pieces, mushrooms, and asparagus - separately in salt water until half-cooked
Place each in cold water and lay on a sieve or cloth to drain

For the cucumbers: place the smallest variety that have been picked in dry weather on a cloth, sprinkle with salt, and rub with the cloth until they become moist, then place on another cloth or sieve to drain slightly
Complete this process for the cucumbers within 1 hour
Line the bottom of prepared glasses with some dill leaves, chervil leaves, and green pepperoni (paprika)
Arrange the cucumbers and then the mixed vegetables in attractive layers, alternating with cucumbers, filling the glasses almost full
For each 1/2 liter glass, add 5 cloves and 5 bitter peppercorns
Pour the prepared cold vinegar over, ensuring the glass is not completely full
For ordinary household use, tie with twine; for storage of glasses, cork and seal them
For storage, keep at a cool, airy location
If the vinegar decreases over time, add water-diluted cold vinegar
If the vinegar becomes cloudy or creamy, strain it off, boil it, let it cool, and pour it back over the vegetables, keeping them covered and weighted at a cool, airy place

title: Gemüseauflauf (Vegetable Soufflé)
description: Prepared with green peas, cabbage, and cauliflower.
steps: Cook the peas, cleaned and washed cabbage sprouts, cauliflower florets, and diced carrots and beans in salted water for 25-30 minutes.
Drain and let drip dry.
In a pot, make a roux with 5 dkg hot butter and 4 dkg flour until light golden, pour in the milk, stir continuously until thick, and let cool.
Mix the cooled sauce with 3 egg yolks, salt, the vegetables, thinly sliced mushrooms sautéed in butter, and 3 beaten egg whites.
Fill into a buttered soufflé dish, bake at moderately high heat for 30-45 minutes.
Serve immediately in the baking dish.

title: Genießer-Zimtsbrötchen (Gourmet Cinnamon Rolls)
description: A bread preparation made with cinnamon, egg yolks, and yeast.

ingredients.name: 4 decagrams pressed yeast dissolved in 1/4 liter lukewarm milk
ingredients.sourceText: 4 decagrams pressed yeast dissolved in 1/4 liter lukewarm milk

ingredients.name: cinnamon mixed with finely ground sugar for sprinkling
ingredients.sourceText: cinnamon mixed with finely ground sugar for sprinkling

steps: Beat the butter until fluffy, mix in the finely ground sugar and salt, then gradually stir in the egg yolks
Mix in the pressed yeast dissolved in lukewarm milk and the flour, stirring well together
Beat the dough until it separates from the spoon
Cover the dough and let it rise in a warm place until doubled in height
Lay the dough on a flour-dusted board, roll it out to the thickness of a knife back, and cut it into strips 3 fingers long and 2 fingers wide
Sprinkle the strips with finely ground sugar mixed with cinnamon, roll them together, and lay them side by side in a butter-greased casserole with the ends of the rolled dough facing upward
Brush the areas where the rolls touch each other with melted butter
Cover with a cloth and let rise in a warm place until slightly higher
Brush with melted butter, pour 1/2 liter of boiling milk mixed with 2 tablespoons sugar over them, and bake slowly for 1 hour
Turn out the casserole, separate the rolls, arrange on a plate, sprinkle with sugar, and serve

title: Genua-Schnitte (Genoa Slices)
description: Prepared with rum, marmalade, and butter.
steps: Place the butter in a deep bowl and stir only slightly so it does not become fluffy
Add 1 whole egg, 1 tablespoon flour and 1 tablespoon sugar, mix together
Repeat this process until all 4 eggs are used
Add the remaining flour and sugar simultaneously, mix well and fold in {{source-4}}

Spread one layer with dissolved marmalade and cover with the second layer so the edges lie evenly
Spread the upper dough also with marmalade, and after it has cooled completely, cover with a transparent glaze
Cut the whole into finger-long and 2 finger-width wide pieces
Can also be served warm with Chaudeau

title: Germ-Waffeln (Yeast Waffles)
description: Prepared with yeast, egg yolks, and orange or lemon or sugar.

ingredients.name: 4 Deca fresh yeast dissolved in 1/8 liter milk
ingredients.sourceText: 4 Deca fresh yeast dissolved in 1/8 liter milk

ingredients.name: butter or unsalted bacon fat for oiling the waffle iron
ingredients.sourceText: butter or unsalted bacon fat for oiling the waffle iron

steps: Gradually beat into 30 Deca beaten butter: 6 egg yolks, 4 Deca orange or lemon sugar, and 4 Deca fresh yeast dissolved in 1/8 liter milk, mixing them one after another.
Lightly fold in the beaten egg whites from 5 eggs together with 30 Deca flour.
Let the dough rise covered in a warm place until it has increased by a third in volume.
Oil both sides of the waffle iron with melted butter or preferably unsalted bacon fat.
Place 2 spoonfuls of the dough in the iron, close it well, place in coals, and after several minutes turn it to the other side and place in the coals for an equal time.
Remove the waffle with two forks, place on a plate, and keep in a warm place.
Continue baking waffles until the dough is used up.
Shortly before serving, sprinkle with sugar and serve with fruit sauce or desired warm sauce.
Note: The first baked waffles usually do not turn out well. Grease the iron moderately but repeatedly. When finished baking, do not wash the iron but only clean it with paper.

description: A pastry dish made with yeast, plum, and egg yolk.
steps: Warm 30 dkg flour in a mixing bowl and crumble in 5 dkg butter
Add 1 egg yolk, 1 whole egg, salt, {{source-8}}, the risen starter (Dampfl), and a few tablespoons lukewarm milk
Beat the dough until it separates from the spoon and let it rise near the stove
When it has nearly doubled in size, use a floured spoon to place small pieces of dough on a floured board
Pull them apart with floured fingers, fill with plum butter, press the edges together, and shape into dumplings
Cook in a saucepan with plenty of boiling salted water for 8-10 minutes
Transfer to a round dish, pour breadcrumbs roasted in fat over them, and serve
Alternative toppings: grated poppy seeds or gingerbread with hot fat poured over

title: Germstrigel (Yeast Braid)
description: Prepared with yeast, currants, and almonds or sugar.

ingredients.name: swollen, chopped almonds or pearl sugar
ingredients.sourceText: swollen, chopped almonds or pearl sugar

steps: Warm the flour in a mixing bowl, rub in 8 dkg cut butter
Add a pinch of salt, 2-3 spoonfuls sugar, 1 egg, yeast leaven from 2 dkg yeast, and some spoonfuls lukewarm milk
Mix the dough and beat it well
On the board, knead it for 20-30 minutes until quite fine
Gradually knead in 5 dkg currants
Divide the dough into 9 parts: 4 large, 3 medium, and 2 small
Form the 4 large parts into fairly long rolls and braid them together
Place on greased baking sheet
Form the remaining parts correspondingly smaller, roll and braid them
Press the four-strand braid in the middle, place the three-strand braid on top, press again, and place the two-strand braid over it
Let the braid rise near the oven
Brush with beaten egg
Sprinkle with swollen, chopped almonds or pearl sugar
Bake in weaker heat until light brown

title: Germteig Finest Style (Finest Yeast Dough)
description: Prepared with yeast, egg yolks, and butter.

ingredients.name: 2 deca pressed yeast dissolved in 1/8 liter lukewarm milk
ingredients.sourceText: 2 deca pressed yeast dissolved in 1/8 liter lukewarm milk

steps: Beat the butter gradually with vanilla sugar, salt, egg yolks, and whole eggs
Add the yeast dissolved in milk and flour, mix well
Beat the dough until it lifts from the spoon
Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled
Place dough on a flour-dusted board, roll out to the thickness of a small finger
Cut out with an oblong pastry cutter
Place half of the obtained pieces on a butter-greased baking sheet at a distance of 2 finger widths apart
Brush with melted butter, sprinkle with vanilla or almond sugar, cover each piece with a lid
Cover with cloth and place in a warm spot
Once the dough has risen somewhat, brush with beaten egg, sprinkle with white pearl sugar, and bake slowly in the oven
When the dough is pale yellow, loosen from the baking sheet with a very thin knife and arrange on a platter

title: Gerste-Soufflé (Barley Soufflé)
description: Prepared with egg yolk, egg yolks, and egg whites.
steps: When a grated barley has been prepared from 1 egg, 1 egg yolk and the necessary flour, stir this into {{source-3}}, cook until thick, stir with 10 Deca butter and 1 pinch of salt and let cool
Meanwhile stir 8 Deca vanilla sugar with 6 egg yolks for 1/2 hour, add the cooled barley, mix well and finally fold in lightly the snow from 11 egg whites
Fill a buttered form dusted with flour and cook covered for 3/4 hours in steam or bake in the oven
When serving, sprinkle the soufflé with finely pounded sugar and serve with dissolved jam or cream

description: A soup made with egg yolk, beef broth, and eggs.
steps: Make a stiff dough from the eggs and flour

In 2 liters of boiling beef broth, add this fine noodle with constant stirring and let it simmer for 8-10 minutes
Remove any foam that forms, strain the soup, and serve at table

title: Geschäumte Bittere Mandel's Creme (Whipped Bitter Almond Cream)
description: Prepared with cream, bitter almonds, and sweet almonds.
steps: Pound 5 bitter and 20 sweet blanched almonds very finely
Cook with {{source-2}} and press through a cloth
Stir with 5 egg yolks and 10 deca sugar over the fire until thick
Pass the mass through a hair sieve into a deep bowl
Add 8 deca dissolved warm isinglass (prepared with {{source-6}} and reduced to 1/8 liter) or 2 deca dissolved gelatin (Coffee Cream with Gelatin No. 1090) to the cream
Stir until it begins to thicken and is completely cold
1 hour earlier, place {{source-10}} in a snow bucket on ice
Beat the cream to stiff foam and fold in the cream
Coat a desired mold with fine oil
Bury in ice and fill with the prepared cream
Let stand several hours
Shortly before serving, dip the mold briefly in hot water, wipe dry quickly and turn out onto a platter
Garnish the cream with meringues or Spanish wind

title: Gesottener Hecht (Boiled Pike)
description: Prepared with pike, bay leaf, and water.
steps: Scale, open and clean the pike
In a fish pan, add necessary water and salt with 1 bay leaf
When the water boils, place the pike in (the water must cover the pike)
As soon as the water returns to boiling, remove from heat
Let the pike stand approximately 3/4 hour while the water maintains simmering temperature but must not boil
When serving, place the pike on a suitable platter or on thin board covered with a napkin that must be sewn together on the underside of the board
Arrange plucked green parsley around it and garnish the fish with diced potatoes boiled in salt water
Serve with melted butter, Hollandaise sauce, thin anchovy sauce, or strained mustard sauce
The cuts in the fish need not necessarily be made
The pike can also be divided into 2-finger-wide pieces, each cut multiple times (scored)

title: Gespickter Lungenbraten (Larded Beef Tenderloin)
description: Prepared with beef, vinegar, and onion.
steps: Take a beautiful beef tenderloin, cleanly remove the skin, cut off the legs and salt it
Make a marinade from one part vinegar and two parts water, add onion pieces, yellow turnips, cut lemon peel, two bay leaves, and some whole pepper
Let it boil well and pour it hot over the beef tenderloin, cover it with a lid and let it stand for twelve to twenty-four hours in a cool place
Take the beef tenderloin and lard it in three or four rows
Remove the onions and yellow turnips from the marinade and lay them in a pan, place the beef tenderloin on top
Add heat above and below and let it braise slowly for two hours until it takes on a yellowish-brown color
Pour one measure of cream milk over the beef tenderloin, let it braise for another quarter hour until the sauce has a beautiful yellow color
Place the beef tenderloin on the dish and serve the sauce underneath

description: Prepared with apples, lemon juice, and juice.

ingredients.name: Green almonds cut into neat pieces
ingredients.sourceText: Green almonds cut into neat pieces

steps: Peel about 10 beautiful apples, hollow out 5 pieces and halve the others
Rub all with lemon and place in cold water with lemon juice to keep them white
Boil 32 deka sugar, {{source-4}}, and the juice of 1/2 lemon, remove the rising foam
Cook the apples in this clarified sugar until somewhat tender
Place them in cold water with some lemon juice
Prepare 2 deka isinglass by stirring it with {{source-7}} and reducing to 1/4 liter
Pour this while still warm into the sugar, mix both together and let it cool
Pour into a mold that has been previously placed in ice, filling finger-high with the sugar mixture
Let this freeze, then arrange the apples very decoratively, finger-width apart, filling the hollowed ones with marmalade
Also use whole redcurrants and neatly cut pieces of Angelica or green almonds
Pour the remaining sugar mixture over, let it set solid, dip the mold briefly in hot water, turn the apples out onto a dish and serve

title: Gewöhnliche braune Suppe (Ordinary Brown Broth)
description: A soup made with fat or beef marrow or lard or veal or kidney or marrow, beef liver, and veal.

ingredients.name: 12 deca leafy-cut fat (beef marrow, lard, veal kidney fat or marrow)
ingredients.sourceText: 12 deca leafy-cut fat (beef marrow, lard, veal kidney fat or marrow)

ingredients.name: spice clove, 3 grains pepper, 3 grains allspice (optional)
ingredients.sourceText: spice clove, 3 grains pepper, 3 grains allspice (optional)

steps: Place leafy-cut fat in a casserolle, either beef marrow, lard, veal kidney fat or marrow
Add 12 deca beef liver, 1 piece veal bone, 1/3 kilo beef broth meat, 1/2 kilo chopped beef bones, 1 piece yellow turnip, 1 piece parsley, and 1 piece onion, all leafy-cut
Cover with a lid, place on fire and let it brown well (brown roast)
Meanwhile, take a table piece weighing approximately 2 kilo, pound it, wash it out, bind it with twine, place it on fire with approximately 4 liters cold water and bring to a boil
Remove the foam that forms cleanly
When the roasted mixture with meat and liver has evaporated well and has taken on a brown color, pour {{source-10}} over it and let it evaporate
After 10 minutes, add a ladle full from the boiling broth and let it cook 10 to 15 minutes
Then add the roasted mixture from the casserolle into the meat pot
If you have poultry scraps, add them to the pot as well, and then let it cook covered for 3 hours slowly
A quarter hour before using the broth, move the pot aside so it no longer boils
Then remove the fat cleanly, strain the broth through fine, clean cloth and use as desired
The meat remains covered in a warm place, after which the twine is removed and the meat is served at table as needed
If you wish to add spices, add a spice clove, 3 grains pepper and 3 grains allspice with the root vegetables

description: Prepared with yeast, fat, and egg yolks.

ingredients.name: 3 Deka yeast dissolved in 1/8 liter lukewarm milk

steps: Place 60 Deka flour in a deep bowl, make a well in the middle, pour in 3 Deka yeast dissolved in 1/8 liter lukewarm milk into this well
Stir it together somewhat, dust it a little with flour and let it stand covered in a warm place
Beat together 8 Deka melted fat, {{source-3}}, 2 egg yolks, 1 whole egg, {{source-6}} and 1 heaping tablespoon sugar and pour this into the so-called sponge after it has risen
Stir well together and beat the dough until it detaches from the spoon
Let it stand covered in a warm place
When the dough has risen somewhat, use a slotted spoon dipped in hot fat to scoop out pieces of desired size, place them in a fat-brushed casserole and brush them on the sides with melted fat
Cover them with a cloth and let them rise somewhat in a warm place
Brush them once more with melted fat and bake them for 3/4 to 1 hour in the oven

ingredients.name: beef and the same amount of veal meat

steps: Place beef, veal, hens, and partridges or pigeons in a pot with {{source-3}}
Cover well and simmer slowly for 6 hours like a stockpot
Strain through hair sieve into a casserole, remove fat completely
Reduce on strong fire to 2 liters, place in earthenware vessel and let stand overnight
Remove the fat that has formed
Place the liquid in a casserole on open fire, stirring constantly until it runs thick from the spoon
Pour into oiled forms, a plate, or casserole and place in an airy cool location
In several days, remove the set glace, cut into desired pieces, and place on a wooden platter in an airy location to dry completely
Wipe the glace from time to time with a clean cloth; if mold appears, wash with cold water and dry with clean cloth
Note: no salt, root vegetables, or spices may be used in this broth, as it would not keep
To use: dissolve 2 decagrams glace in ½ liter cold water with salt to taste, bring slowly to boil for good meat soup
Can also be used for sauces

title: Glasiertes Apfelkompott (Glazed Apple Compote)
description: Prepared with apples, sugar, and water.
steps: Hollow out the cores from 20 Maschanzger apples, then peel them and throw them in fresh water.
Make a caramel from one quarter pound sugar, and as soon as it takes on a yellowish color, remove it from the fire.
Lay the apples next to one another in the casserole, pour a small glass of water to it, add a lemon peel, and let it cook slowly and well covered until the apples are soft and glazed.
Let them cool and arrange them on the compote dish.
From what remains in the casserole, cook a syrup with one quarter pound sugar and some water, pass it through a hair sieve, and when it is cold, pour it over the apples.

title: Goulash
description: Prepared with beef or tenderloin, bacon, and onion.

ingredients.name: Beef from the front quarters of the ox, or tenderloin
ingredients.sourceText: Beef from the front quarters of the ox, or tenderloin

steps: For goulash, choose a well-aged piece of beef from the front quarters of the ox. Tenderloin can also be used if it is not too expensive.
After cleaning the meat thoroughly, cut it into pieces of desired size, cube-shaped.
Place 16 decagrams of cube-cut bacon in a casserole and let it roast until it looks glassy.
Add 1 large head onion, finely chopped, and let it roast a little.
Add the meat and 1 teaspoon of caraway seeds, let it cook covered until the resulting liquid has evaporated.
Add enough stock so that it covers the meat.
Only when the meat is tender, season it with salt and the point of a knife full of paprika (or as desired with paprika alone) and let it boil a little.
The sauce should not be too thin when running from the spoon.
Before serving, the fat should be removed carefully.

title: Grazer Zwieback (Graz Rusks)
description: Prepared with egg whites, flour, and butter.
steps: Stir 13 dkg vanilla sugar and 11 dkg flour with a wooden spoon into 5 stiff egg whites.
Mix in 5 dkg melted, hot butter.
Fill the mass into the buttered, floured biscuit form and bake slowly.
The next day, cut the rusks into thin slices and place on a baking rack or sheet in the open oven to dry.
The slices must be dried slowly and become beautifully white and fine, feeling hard on both sides.
Immediately roll them on a flat plate in very finely sieved vanilla sugar.
If well dried, they keep for a very long time.
The mass in the form should only be two fingers high, otherwise it will not bake through and is difficult to dry properly.

title: Grilled Ox Palate with Skewers (Grillirte Ochſengaumen mit Spießchen)
description: Prepared with calf's udder, liquid, and beef.

ingredients.name: clear broth or Sauce Espagnole or clear piquant sauce
ingredients.sourceText: clear broth or Sauce Espagnole or clear piquant sauce

steps: Clean the ox palate and remove the skin
Cook it soft with calf's udder in a braise
Cool until it can be removed and cut into large, even cubes
Put a quarter pound beef lard in a casserole
Sauté thinly sliced truffles and mushrooms with finely chopped parsley and onions
Dust with proportional flour
Fill with the braising liquid
Cook briefly and bind with 6 or 8 egg yolks so the sauce becomes quite thick
Set the diced palate pieces into it
Draw off with lemon juice and set it cold again
On a silver skewer thread the palate pieces, alternating with truffle and udder and mushrooms
Coat evenly with sauce
Roll in fine, white grated bread and continue until everything is well covered with bread
Melt a good piece of butter and stir it with some egg yolk
Dip each skewer in it and coat thickly with grated bread
Fry on three sides on a grate, and give the fourth side color with a glowing shovel
Serve with clear, strong broth or Sauce Espagnole or clear piquant sauce

title: Grösel Torte ohne Eier (Brioche Cake without Eggs)
description: A cake made with juice, almonds, and egg white.

ingredients.name: 40 deca almonds, peeled and finely pounded
ingredients.sourceText: 40 deca almonds, peeled and finely pounded

steps: Beat 30 deca beaten butter with 16 deca cinnamon sugar and the juice of 1 lemon.
Gradually mix in 40 deca peeled and finely pounded almonds (mixed with the juice of a second lemon), some finely cut lemon peel, and 30 deca flour.
Roll out the dough finger-thick on a flour-dusted board.
Cut two round discs and place them in a buttered cake form dusted with flour.
Fill between the two discs with preserved fruit filling.
Brush the upper disc with beaten egg white and lay strips of dough (rolled into little fingers' thickness) across it in a lattice pattern.
Brush the lattice also with beaten egg white and bake at low heat for approximately 1 hour.
After this time, place the cake on a sieve and after it has cooled completely, fill the four corners of the lattice with preserved filling of choice.
Sprinkle with vanilla sugar and serve.
This cake is hard and can easily crack when cutting.

title: Grüne Bohnen mit Schöpsenfleisch (Green Beans with Mutton)
description: Prepared with beans, mutton, and cream.
steps: Cut young beans after removing stems and any fibers into small diagonal pieces and wash
Place butter in a casserole, let the beans sweat for a while, then pour cream over them and let them cook soft
Combine the cream with a pair of egg yolks from the beans and pour back over them, but do not boil further
At serving, sprinkle a little butter over them and top with cooked mutton meat

Alternatively: boil the cut beans in salt water, braise them in butter when drained, add finely cut shallots, pepper, salt, and pile in the center of the platter, then garnish with mutton cutlets, feet, sausages, or only with bread fried in butter

Or: cook the cut and rinsed beans in sufficiently salted meat broth, place in a casserole, pour some of the broth over them, add a little butter, nutmeg and ginger, and let cook; then add roux or bread crumbs and let the broth become thick, and garnish as desired

Or: without thickening, beat three egg yolks in a pot, add some vinegar, whisk thoroughly, add a little butter, pour the bean broth underneath, and whisk constantly so it does not curdle; finally pour the broth over the beans and let it soak through without boiling further
When serving, sprinkle with melted butter

steps: Sort and wash the peas

Serve with bread slices

title: Grüne Suppe von Erbsen (Green Pea Soup)
description: A soup made with green peas, leek, and onions.

ingredients.name: fresh green peas that are beginning to thicken
ingredients.sourceText: fresh green peas that are beginning to thicken

ingredients.name: lean ham cut into cubes
ingredients.sourceText: 1 pound lean ham cut into cubes

ingredients.name: white bread cut into small cubes
ingredients.sourceText: white bread cut into small cubes

steps: Put an appropriate amount of fresh green peas into a casserole, cover with water, add 2 stalks of leek and some onions, and cook until done.
When all the water has cooked down, pound the peas in a mortar.
Melt {{source-4}}, stir in one spoon of flour until it foams.
Add 1 pound of lean ham cut into cubes, stir the pounded peas through it, and add enough broth so the peas become properly thick.
Let this cook together for half an hour.
Pound a handful of fresh washed spinach finely in a mortar.
When the soup is properly thick and cooked down, strain it through a hair cloth along with the pounded spinach, then pass it through a sieve into a suitable pot.
Add necessary salt and keep it hot until serving.
Fry white bread cut into small cubes in butter until brown and hard, remove with a skimming spoon, and lay on paper to drain the fat.
Serve the soup over the fried bread cubes.
